feat(home): a solution-first story; new pages for features and about

## Intent

The home page spoke to neither parents nor teachers. It opened with a problem that is the platform's, not theirs, and reached the solution only in its third section. It should start with the promise and tell one short story, with the passion of parents and teachers who build apps as its thread. Features and the founder's view belong on pages of their own.

## Key changes

- Home page: "Lern-Apps ohne Haken." with four badges; four apps from the catalogue; what teachers (a covering lesson) and parents (practise tonight, with the AI tutor of the explainer apps) get; "Ein solides Fundament für Macher"; "Noch eine Plattform?" answered with "diese gehört keiner Firma"; how to join; a short word from the founder.
- The persona tabs, the problem quotes and the box "Frag deinen KI-Assistenten" leave the home page, and with them its script and stylesheet.
- /features/: the principles, what the apps can do (the three foundations, curriculum, feedback, deep links, AI tutor, accessibility), and technical transparency for developers: why it works without money, how an app gets into the catalogue, stack, ownership and licence.
- /about/: the founder's long text (digital education has an ecosystem problem, not a device problem) and the answer for sceptics, moved from the home page.
- All three pages in English too; README and llms.txt name the new pages.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The home page has no script any more.
- The app cards no longer say who built them, so the home page names the founder once.
